body.name: dotc
body.type: chart derivative of the completed target post mean
body.def: \(\dot c(u)=D_\theta[d(\theta)^{\prime}A(\theta)^+a_0(\theta)]_{\theta=\theta_0}[u]\), where \(d(\theta_0)^{\prime}A(\theta_0)^+a_0(\theta_0)=c_{0,0}\); equivalently, \(\dot c(u)=D_\theta d_{\theta_0}[u]^{\prime}A_0^+a_{0,0}+d_0^{\prime}A_0^+\{D_\theta a_{0,\theta_0}[u]-D_\theta A_{\theta_0}[u]A_0^+a_{0,0}\}\) along the fixed-rank compatible chart.
